ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels in the central region and 25% high-intensity (white) pixels at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous dark mass covering the interior lobes and notch area. High-intensity white blobs at the distal left and right tips, with significant dark pixel encroachment in the form of linear and mottled patterns.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Sharp, irregular peaks and valleys prominent on the right lobe edge against the sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve on the leading edges meeting at the peduncle; concave sweep on the trailing edges toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single dark circular pixel cluster (rosette) visible on the upper distal portion of the right lobe within the white pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of high-contrast white linear streaks; prominent parallel 'rake mark' sets on the left lobe and intersecting thin white scratches across the central dark region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake markings consistent with predator interaction on the left ventral surface; distinctive circular marking on the distal right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly organized, parallel linear scarring patterns on the left lobe's interior dark pigment area.
